embeds.title: 🔴 Laravel-Lang PHP Packages Compromised in Supply Chain Attack
embeds.description:
Cybersecurity researchers flagged a supply chain attack targeting multiple PHP packages belonging to Laravel-Lang organization. The attack delivered a credential-stealing framework through compromised packages (laravel-lang/lang, laravel-lang/http-statuses, laravel-lang/attributes, laravel-lang/actions). More than 700 malicious versions were published on May 22-23, 2026. The malware, embedded in src/helpers.php, contacts flipboxstudio[.]info to retrieve a PHP-based payload that steals cloud credentials, cryptocurrency wallet data, browser data, VPN configurations, and other sensitive information from Windows, Linux, and macOS systems. Socket and Aikido Security reported the attack involved automated mass tagging suggesting compromise of organization-level credentials or release infrastructure.
**Sources:** thehackernews.com • 🔴 1 corroborating
**CVEs:** none • **Access:** Compromised package repository / supply chain
**Incident date:** 2026-05-22 • **Confidence:** claim
[Read source](https://thehackernews.com/2026/05/laravel-lang-php-packages-compromised.html)
